BiblicalUsage: Hobah is the place north of Damascus where Abram's night pursuit of the kings ends. The name appears once, as a marker on the edge of the battle. Abram does not stop at the border of the fight; he follows until his kinsman is recovered.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Hobah matters because it shows how far Abram would go for Lot. Love does not stop at a convenient distance.
